text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Fuji Kiseki having shone so brightly 
through her overwhelming star power and 
skill, the discovery of her injury sent 
shockwaves not only through the academy, 
but among the fans as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For Marvelous Sunday, racing against Fuji 
Kiseki was a beacon of hope. But that 
dream was no longer meant to be...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, focusing on what can be done 
right now— the marvelous mindset she has 
shown all along drives him forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Diligently training alongside Marvelous 
Sunday today as well. Delivering results 
will surely serve as words of 
encouragement for Fuji Kiseki.
